name: Goddess Realm
source:
Omnia is a fantasy world filled with only deviant women. Succubi, vampires, werewolves, witches, and more! But the goddess has grown bored of her world and wants to spice things up. So she created the first human male and placed him in her realm. That human male is you. Meet a growing cast of beautiful and exotic women, seduce them, help them, and do all sorts of naughty things with them! Are you the nice guy, the flirty gentleman, or the aggressive type?

[from [url=https://sexyversecomics.itch.io/goddess-realm]Itch.io[/url]]

Omnia是一個奇幻世界，這裡只有性情放縱的女性：魅魔、吸血鬼、狼人、女巫，還有更多種族！可女神對自己的世界感到厭倦，想添些刺激，於是創造了第一位人類男性，將他放進自己的領域。而這位男性，就是你。結識不斷增多的美麗異族女性，誘惑她們、幫助她們，與她們做各種壞壞的事！你會是溫柔好人、擅長調情的紳士，還是強勢進攻的類型？
